newsitem.title: USA: Zions Bancorp to acquire Tri-State Bank.
newsitem.headline: Zions Bancorp to acquire Tri-State Bank.

text.p: Zions Bancorp said Thursday it has definitively agreed to acquire Tri-State Bank, an Idaho bank with $24 million in assets, in exchange for Zion shares.
The acquisition is subject to approval of Tri-State shareholders and banking regulators. It will be a tax-free exchange of shares and is expected to close in July, Zions said.

Zions said under their pact, Tri-State will help it complete the pending acquisition of certain Wells Fargo branches in Idaho. It said the ten Wells Fargo branches to be acquired in Idaho have aggregate deposits of $139 million.
Zions has assets of $7.2 billion and operates in Utah, Arizona, and Nevada.
